Simply set the desired speed and the system uses GPS navigation data to maintain that speed without driver intervention - including slowing down for curves and anticipating hills. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
  • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
Safety and Security
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
    Safety and Security
    • Hands-off cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-off cruise control.
    • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
    • Rear camera with washer - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you.     • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.

An active blind spot system not only alerts you to the presence of a vehicle to your sides or rear but helps prevent you from making an unsafe lane change. Replace fear and uncertainty with the confidence and safety of the Active blind spot system.
    • Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.

description: Experience luxury and performance with this 2022 BMW X5 M50i, a stylish SUV that balances power and comfort. With just over 34,900 miles, this used vehicle offers a robust 4.4-liter twin-turbo V8 engine delivering 523 horsepower and 553 lb-ft of torque, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission. Its AWD system ensures confident handling on diverse terrains, making every drive engaging. The X5 M50i combines practicality with advanced technology, featuring Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, a premium audio system, and a navigation setup that keeps you connected and entertained. The vehicle’s interior boasts leather seats, heated options, memory settings, and a sunroof, while the hands-free liftgate and keyless entry add convenience. Rear A/C, satellite radio, and WiFi hotspot capabilities enhance comfort and connectivity, making this SUV a versatile choice for both daily commutes and weekend adventures. This used BMW X5 M50i is packed with safety and security features designed to protect you and your passengers. Dual front knee airbags, active head restraints, and four-wheel ABS provide a solid safety foundation, complemented by parking sensors on the front and rear for easy maneuvering. Traffic sign recognition and collision warning help prevent accidents, while emergency braking preparation and cornering brake control add extra layers of security. The regenerative braking system and premium brakes ensure reliable stopping power, making this SUV both safe and confident on the road. 2022 BMW X5 Safety and Security Features This model is equipped with essential safety features including dual front knee airbags and active head restraints, providing comprehensive protection. Traffic sign recognition assists in maintaining awareness of road conditions, while the premium brakes and 4-wheel ABS ensure reliable stopping. Parking sensors on both the front and rear facilitate easier parking and maneuvering in tight spots. The regenerative braking system improves efficiency by recapturing energy during deceleration. Emergency braking preparation and cornering brake control work together to enhance stability and safety during sudden stops or sharp turns. 2022 BMW X5 Entertainment and Technology Features The X5 M50i offers advanced tech to keep you connected and entertained. A 12.3-inch infotainment screen dominates the dashboard, featuring voice-operated radio and hands-free phone call integration, ensuring easy access while driving. The premium sound system includes 14 speakers and two subwoofers, delivering surround sound in 5.1 channels for an immersive experience. Compatibility with BMW ConnectedDrive allows for smart device app functions, including phone-as-a-key and engine start/cabin preconditioning. Satellite radio and HD radio options keep entertainment options endless, enhancing every journey with high-quality audio. 2022 BMW X5 Performance Features Performance is at the heart of this X5 M50i, equipped with an active suspension system and a sport-tuned suspension for optimized handling. A performance exhaust enhances the engine’s sound, while electronic suspension control allows driver customization of ride comfort. Auto start/stop technology improves efficiency, and the locking rear differential provides better traction during challenging conditions. The full-time 4WD system ensures stable power delivery and control across varied terrains. Suspension ride control can be adjusted to suit your driving style, offering a dynamic and engaging experience behind the wheel.

Gear changes occur almost imperceptibly, helping preserve the Navigator's quiet and refined character while maximizing performance when needed. The Navigator's sophisticated suspension tuning is one of its greatest achievements. Despite its size, it delivers a remarkably smooth ride that isolates occupants from road imperfections. Long-distance travel becomes exceptionally comfortable, while adaptive suspension technology helps maintain composure and control regardless of driving conditions. The exterior design projects confidence and sophistication from every angle. Lincoln's distinctive grille, elegant lighting signatures, substantial proportions, and premium detailing create a vehicle with unmistakable presence. Unlike some luxury SUVs that emphasize aggression, the Navigator communicates prestige through elegance and refinement. Inside, the cabin is where the Navigator Black Label truly distinguishes itself. Three-row seating provides exceptional accommodations throughout the vehicle, while premium materials, exquisite craftsmanship, and meticulous attention to detail create an atmosphere worthy of a flagship luxury vehicle. Seating for seven allows family members and guests to travel in first-class comfort. Technology is naturally one of the Navigator's greatest strengths. The advanced infotainment system integrates navigation, media, connectivity, vehicle settings, voice-command functionality, smartphone integration, and numerous convenience features into an intuitive interface. Connected services may require subscription. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety.
